API_CLI.opt_in: New boolean flag defaultsfalse. Existing positional/parser API and verify_case_source_bundle output are unchanged when omitted. No autodetection from provider/metadata.
API_CLI.error_contract: ValueError for malformed known schema/syntax with generic field labels only. CLI exit2 via ordinary validation path; known mismatch exit1; completed audit unknown/matched exit0. Existing non-opt-in error contract unchanged.

binding.unknown_fields: ValueError for recognized v1 at every defined object; no caller verified/approved flags

native_record.source_type_scope: public_disclosure only in v1. Other otherwise-valid source types are outside scope/unknown, not silently adapted.
nullable_failure_fields: response.status_code null when no HTTP response
artifacts.extracted_text null and extraction null when no output exists
native_record.success_requires_nonnull: On 200/complete/error-null path: headers/body completion, extracted_text artifact and extraction object/text are all required nonnull.

types.versions: type(value) is int, >=1; bool/float/null/containers rejected before dispatch
types.status_code: null or strict int100..599; bool/float rejected
types.error: null or nonempty string, never emitted
types.times: offset-aware strings via models.timestamp; local wrapper returns generic label on malformed values, no offending value echoed
types.hash: required lowercase64 hex; implementation.sha256 only may be null because no implementation identity verification is done
types.URLs: nonempty http(s) strings checked as references; exact lexical equality request.url=response.url=source.url for this no-redirect v1. No normalization/redirect lookup. Never emitted in audit/errors.
types.content_length_header: null or decimal digit string only; shape declared, not compared to decoded entity bytes
types.UTF8_text: strings encodable as strictUTF8; extracted bytes decoded directly, no universal newline translation or silent BOM stripping

synthetic_coherent_example_not_files_cre.example_artifact_JSON_serialization: UTF8 json.dumps ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True,separators comma-colon + finalLF. Snapshot hash alone uses existing json_text with no finalLF. These are illustrative synthetic bytes, not retrieved sources.

Object key may be empty/01/-; array index must be0 or[1-9][0-9]*ASCII; no -, leadingzero, negative/floats. Missing valid ref=>unknown, malformed syntax/index=>validationerror.
Apply pointer only after artifact SHA/count matched. Selectednative record declares its ownformat/version; outercontainer schema not searched.
Strictparse entire pinnedJSON artifact rejects duplicate/nonfinite values even in unselected siblings.
path_contract: binding path must stay repository_root, existing core API boundary. case_root explicit repository-relative resolved inside repository.
raw/transport/source/output artifact paths are relative to explicitcase_root only; reject absolute/../NUL/symlink escape before read. No parent/bundle-dir inference.
Missing declared file=>unknown; required schemafield absent=>ValueError. No read of missing/outside targets. Files assumedstable; no OSfd race-hardening or writer lock introduced.

Hash/count pin capture artifact, strictpointer select one native record; exactformat/version dispatch. Recognizedrequired objects/enums/types validated.
